newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV OUT OF RUSSIA'S DAVIS CUP TIE WITH SAFRICA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV OUT OF RUSSIA'S DAVIS CUP TIE WITH SAFRICA.

text.p: Russia face their Davis Cup tie against South Africa next month without their star player -- world number five Yevgeny Kafelnikov.

"His little finger is still in plaster. In about two weeks doctors say they will remove the plaster and he will resume training sessions in about three weeks," Alexander Kalivod, the Russian Tennis Federation's first vice-president, said on Thursday.
Kafelnikov, who broke his finger shortly before the start of the Australian Open, is being treated in Germany.
The squad for the February 7-9 tie in South Africa will be made up of Alexander Volkov, Andrei Chesnokov, Andrei Olkhovsky and Andrei Cherkasov.
Kalivod said Kafelnikov would join the tournament as soon as he recovered from his injury, if Russia were still in. Last year Russia lost to Italy in the first round.
